items.title: Former UK Prime Minister Liz Truss says bond rout could force emergency spending cuts
items.summary: The former prime minister said U.K. is among the worst examples of rising debt and warns the situation may have gone too far.

items.title: Core DAO plans emergency hard fork after validators drew excess rewards
items.summary: Core says the incident is contained and its planned forward upgrade will not roll back the network or reverse previously confirmed transactions.

items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 3, 2026

items.title: The yen is surging and it’s helping bitcoin, for now
items.summary: Yen's rise has led to a broad-based USD weakness, driving the Dollar Index lower. BTC and gold are loving it, for now.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin shrugs off higher oil prices as Japanese yen rallies
items.summary: Bitcoin is back above $77,500 with every major green on the day, though the week still reads red. Global investors are carrying their lowest currency protection on U.S. assets in a decade.

items.title: Bitcoin recovers toward $78,000 as pons and arbitrum extend Robinhood Chain rally
items.summary: BTC rose 0.76% since midnight as a softer dollar lifted equities and metals alongside crypto, while ARB and PONS pushed higher for a third session.

items.title: Australia is cracking down on crypto businesses as its strict new regulatory deadline nears
items.summary: Firms that miss the deadline could breach financial services law from Oct. 1 and face civil or criminal penalties.

items.title: CFTC asks judge to dismiss CME lawsuit over crypto perpetual futures
items.summary: The regulator claims the dispute is "much ado about nothing," noting that the order allows any designated contract market, including CME, to list these products.

items.title: Catastrophe bonds may join tokenization rush, with plans for test issuance in 2027
items.summary: A law firm and a tokenization platform say their proposed structure would give investors legal ownership of cat bonds onchain and could lower the minimum investment.

items.title: Bitcoin’s fabled golden cross is coming. And USDT may be the real signal this time
items.summary: BTC is nearing a bullish golden cross, a widely tracked signal with a mixed record of success in crypto markets. But this time, USDT is supporting the bullish read.

items.title: Dogecoin becomes only losing bet for Japan-listed firm as it sells altcoins for bitcoin
items.summary: Remixpoint booked gains on ether, solana and XRP, but sold DOGE below its fiscal-year opening value as it concentrated its crypto holdings in bitcoin.

items.title: Bitcoin back above $77,500, XRP leads majors as Fed hike odds slide to 62%
items.summary: Every major token is green over 24 hours, though only zcash and hyperliquid are holding gains on the week.

items.title: Pencil Finance completes $1M onchain lending cycle for 6.6K students in Southeast Asia
items.summary: Pencil Finance said that its first-of-a-kind loan offered financing to 6,600 students in Southeast Asia who were underserved by traditional lenders.

items.title: Standard Chartered launches spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in UAE
items.summary: Standard Chartered said it is the first major global bank to offer institutional access to spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in the UAE region.

items.title: Coldcard hacker swaps stolen Bitcoin for ETH via THORChain
items.summary: The third-wave Coldcard exploiter moved about 10% of stolen funds through THORChain as researchers traced the assets to a new Ethereum address.

items.title: Kalshi seeks CFTC approval for WTI crude perpetual futures: Report
items.summary: Kalshi reportedly plans to file for approval of a WTI crude oil perpetual futures contract that would trade around the clock five days a week without an expiration date.

items.title: Australia warns unlicensed crypto firms of fines up to 10% of annual turnover
items.summary: ASIC has recorded more than 45 digital asset-related license applications as its temporary enforcement relief approaches Sept. 30 expiration.

items.title: Ether, XRP ETF inflow streaks end as Bitcoin funds rebound
items.summary: Ether ETFs posted $48 million in outflows after attracting $1.62 billion over 12 trading days, while XRP funds ended an 11-session inflow run.
